title: GraphRAG for Drone Design
summary: Exploring graph-based retrieval to connect drone design knowledge across technical documents. Follow the research through five presentation PDFs, from RAG fundamentals to comparative experiments and ontology-guided improvements.
overview: This ongoing research explores how GraphRAG can support drone design by organizing technical evidence into knowledge graphs and hierarchical communities. The materials document RAG and KG-RAG foundations, document chunking and table-aware retrieval, experiments comparing Vector RAG with GraphRAG, and proposed improvements for entity disambiguation and table preservation.

documents.description: Knowledge graph construction and community visualization, ontology-guided entity disambiguation, and preserving table evidence.

documents.title: Drone GraphRAG vs. Vector RAG: Comparative Experiments
documents.description: GraphRAG foundations, hierarchical communities, and comparative question-answering experiments using drone documents.

documents.title: GraphRAG & KG-RAG with Contextual Chunking
